item.description: Terrance Walker asked Vape store owner Abdallah “Jordan” Rubeha if he wanted to die before shooting him point blank in the head a year ago. The post Three men sentenced to life for murder of Augusta vape shop owner appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Pedestrian killed on Deans Bridge Road identified as 51-year-old woman
item.description: A 51-year-old woman was killed Saturday night after being struck by a vehicle while walking along Deans Bridge Road, according to the Richmond County Sheriff’s Office and the coroner. item.title: Augusta man wanted for aggravated stalking escapes deputies on Interstate 20
item.description: Authorities are searching for an Augusta man after a traffic stop on Interstate 20 in Taliaferro County ended with the driver fleeing on foot, according to the Taliaferro County Sheriff’s Office. The post Augusta man wanted for aggravated stalking escapes deputies on Interstate 20 appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Book ban versus parent control, lawmakers debate purpose of bill that could send librarians to jail
item.description: Legislation to strip librarians of their criminal immunity from a law that makes it illegal to give “harmful” books and other content to minors is moving quickly through the Georgia General Assembly, after passing a House committee in a partisan vote Friday. The post Book ban versus parent control, lawmakers debate purpose of bill that could send librarians to jail appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Italian American Club brings back Pasta Festival with takeout-only mini event Feb. 13
item.description: After two consecutive Octobers derailed by Hurricane Helene, the Italian American Club of the CSRA is bringing back its Pasta Festival in a smaller format with a takeout-only fundraiser on Friday, Feb. 13.
